story:
Why this one matters: the NBA is in its offseason. The WNBA just locked an eight-team field and the playoffs begin 27 September. If you want basketball that still has a scoreboard in September, this is it.

WNBA.com standings: Minnesota Lynx 31-9, Golden State Valkyries 29-11, Las Vegas Aces 27-13, Atlanta Dream 26-14, Indiana Fever 26-14, New York Liberty 24-16, Washington Mystics 24-16, Dallas Wings 24-16. First round is best of three. Semifinals best of five. Finals best of seven for the second time.

The Aces are the defending champions from 2025. The Lynx have the one-seed. The Valkyries, in year two, have the two-seed. Do not invent a 2026 champion. The games have not started.
stakes: Home court, a one-seed, a 27 September start.
rivalryAngle: Lynx versus a field that includes last year's champions and a second-year Valkyries side.
